info.title: OSPF_Vlink
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

destination_ip_address.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the virtual neighbor.

ipsec_ah.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec  Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). AH SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ipsec_ah_sas.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SA](#/IPsec_SA)
List of IPsec AH Security Associations (SA). Generally, two SAs are referenced for each unicast addresses. One unicast SA will use OSPF neighbor ip address as `dest_prefix` for outgoing packets and the other will use OSPF source ip address as `dest_prefix` for incoming packets.

ipsec_esp.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), encryption/authentication type and key to use. IPsec Authentication Header (AH) is preferred over IPsec ESP if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). ESP SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ipsec_esp_sas.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SA](#/IPsec_SA)
List of IPsec ESP SAs. Generally, two SAs are referenced for each unicast addresses. One unicast SA will use OSPF neighbor ip address as `dest_prefix` for outgoing packets and the other will use OSPF source ip address as `dest_prefix` for incoming packets.

ipsec_sps.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SP](#/IPsec_SP)
List of IPsec Security Policies (SP). Generally, two SPs are referenced for each unicast addresses. One unicast SP will use OSPF source ip address as `src_prefix` for outgoing packets and the other will use OSPF source ip address as `dest_prefix` for incoming packets.

lsa_counts.description: Specifies the virtual-link lsa count. link_lsa - Number of link-state advertisements (LSAs)  in the link state database for the virtual link.

ospf_auth_keychain.description:
Reference Resource: [Keychain](#/Keychain)
The "Keychain" used for cryptographic authentication. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 algorithms. If not set, OSPF keychain authentication is not operational.

ospf_auth_md5_keys.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type "md5" message-digest.

ospf_auth_sha_keys.description: The authentication keys for OSPFv2 authentication type "sha".

ospf_auth_text_key.description: The authentication key for OSPFv2 authentication type "text". If not set, authentication key is not operational.

ospf_auth_type.description: The type of OSPFv2 authentication. If not set, then the area level authentication of the transit area, holds for the port.

dead_interval.description: The time, in seconds, that a neighbor waits for a Hello packet before tearing down adjacency with local router.

hello_interval.description: The time, in seconds, between successive Hello packets.

retransmit_interval.description: The estimated time, in seconds, between successive LSAs.

transmit_delay.description: The estimated time, in seconds, to transmit an LSA to a neighbor.

virtual_ifindex.description: The Virtual Link Index assigned to the ospfv3 virtual interface.

peer_router_id.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Vlink](#/OSPF_Vlink)
The list of all the "OSPF_Vlink" for the OSPF Area, which contains the OSPF Virtual link related configurations. The Peer Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

source_ip_address.description: IPv4/IPv6 source address of the virtual link.

state_changes.description: The total number of state changes on the virtual-link.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics for this OSPF virtual-link have  been cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for  this OSPF virtual-link.

statistics_clear_time.description: Time when statistics were last cleared in seconds since the Unix  epoch.

lsa_checksum_sum.description: The 32-bit unsigned sum of the virtual link LSA checksums.

destination_ip_address.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the virtual neighbor.

ipsec_ah.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec  Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

ipsec_ah_sas.description:

ospf_auth_keychain.description:

ospf_auth_type.description: The type of OSPFv2 authentication. If not set, then the area level authentication of the transit area, holds for the port.

dead_interval.description: The time, in seconds, that a neighbor waits for a Hello packet before tearing down adjacency with local router.
